meta.parties: Waharaka Investment Co., Ltd. v. Commissioner of Stamps

rules.statement: An instrument transferring shares is chargeable with duty based on the consideration specified in the instrument, even if that consideration differs significantly from the market value of the shares.
rules.supporting_quote: "The transfer of these shares was to the Company for the price specified in the instrument of conveyance. Whatever arrangements or understanding there may have been between Ramage Dawson and the signatories or any of them prior to the incorporation, there is no evidence upon which it can be found that the Company gave any consideration for the transfer of these shares other than or in addition to the pecuniary consideration mentioned in the instrument."
